name: Nullweave Tier-4 Augment-Display Formal Suit
description: Where Tier 3 hides augmentation behind standard seams and Tier 5 renders it irrelevant through sheer tailoring, Tier 4 does something more interesting: it puts the chrome on display. The Nullweave aug-display formal suit is cut for the specialist who has earned their chrome and wants the boardroom to know it. The jacket is a slim double-breasted cut in Nullweave's signature light-absorbing matte black fabric — not true vantablack, but a deep structural dark that reads as a void against the office's fluorescent ambience. The left sleeve is constructed with a full open-channel system: a structured chrome-display cut that runs from shoulder to wrist, framing a mechanical arm or chrome forearm prosthetic with a border of matte black piping that makes the augmentation look intentional rather than accommodated. The right sleeve is standard. Trousers are the same matte black Nullweave fabric, slim through the thigh with a moderate break, and a single aug-channel seam along the outer right leg for a prosthetic limb or exo-brace. The shirt beneath is a Nullweave house poplin in deep charcoal — not white, a deliberate departure. A slim matte-black tie with a single diagonal line of micro-reflective thread. Footwear is Meridian Standard Chrome-Last boots in black, the chrome toe-cap polished to mirror finish — the only reflective surface in the ensemble, and clearly intentional. The BCI port at the temple is left uncovered, the port itself brushed steel.
functionality: Full open-channel left sleeve display system for chrome arm augmentation, right leg aug-channel seam for prosthetic or exo-brace, uncovered BCI port with brushed steel cosmetic surround, anti-glare matte fabric reduces visual tracking by standard security systems, aug-channel magnetic closure for clean silhouette when chrome is absent
what_it_says: You worked for the chrome and you're not going to put it in a sleeve. You are a specialist — your augmentation is proof of investment, expertise, and a history that the Tier 3 pool doesn't have. You wear the open channel as a credential. The matte black says you understand aesthetics. The chrome toe-cap says you understand contrast.
worn_by: anyone whose augmentation was paid for by their corponation and who considers that a point of pride
manufacturer: Nullweave Atelier — ready-to-wear with aug-channel customization fitting, 2-week lead time
story_hooks: The open-channel display system in the left sleeve is designed to frame chrome augmentation as an aesthetic choice — but it also means the augmentation is fully visible and scannable. A character wearing this suit walks into a meeting and realizes too late that someone in the room has a scanner that can read the serial number on their chrome arm, which traces back to a manufacturer that shouldn't exist.

The matte Nullweave fabric has a secondary property its marketing material doesn't mention: it absorbs and re-emits ambient BCI broadcast signals at a slight delay, creating a ghost presence in building sensor logs — the suit appears in the record two seconds after the wearer actually passed a checkpoint.

A Tier 3 character acquires this suit and wears it into a Tier 4 access zone. The aug-channel sleeve is empty — they have no chrome. A specialist in the elevator notices the empty channel, the uncovered BCI port, and the chrome-last boots, does a slow calculation, and says nothing. Whether that silence is mercy or something else becomes relevant in the next scene.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sharp, deliberate formal silhouette that treats augmentation as design statement rather than concealment. The left sleeve frames chrome prosthetics as architectural feature. Overall impression: a specialist who has earned their modifications and wears them to the boardroom without apology.
physical_description.fit: Slim double-breasted jacket with structured tailoring. Trousers slim through thigh with moderate break. Compression-adjacent but not restrictive — designed for someone with integrated hardware.
physical_description.primary_material: Nullweave signature matte-black light-absorbing structural fabric (jacket and trousers). Deep charcoal poplin (shirt). Brushed steel accent (BCI port frame).
physical_description.texture: Matte, light-absorbing surfaces throughout — fabric reads almost as void in standard lighting. Sharp contrast provided by mirror-polished chrome toe-cap and brushed steel BCI port. Micro-reflective thread on tie catches light subtly.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant deep matte black with charcoal undertones. Single accent: mirror-polished chrome on boot toe-caps and framing augmentation channels. Micro-reflective diagonal thread on tie.
physical_description.closures: Double-breasted jacket with implied button/magnetic closure. Standard trousers with implied fastening. Open-channel system on left sleeve and right leg allows augmentation integration without traditional fastening.
distinctive_features: Full open-channel system on left sleeve (shoulder to wrist) framing augmentation display
Matte black piping borders aug-channel, making prosthetic integration intentional
Single aug-channel seam on outer right leg
Exposed, uncovered BCI port at temple with brushed steel framing
Mirror-polished chrome toe-caps on boots as sole reflective element
Micro-reflective diagonal thread on tie (catches light when moving)
Charcoal shirt instead of traditional white — signal of intentional departure from corpo standard
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4 — working-class specialist with earned augmentations. Affordable bespoke customization (2-week lead time) signals stability and technical skill, not raw wealth.
physical_description.cultural_context: The wearer is a specialist (engineer, surgeon, combat tech, interface specialist) who has integrated chrome through work rather than choice. The suit says: I've earned this hardware and I'm not hiding it. Appeals to corpo-adjacent professionals, security contractors, medical technicians, and augmentation designers.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to broken-in. The fabric is chosen to hide wear — scuffs blend into the matte-black void. Augmentation-display channels remain crisp. BCI port brushed steel develops a light patina over time.

image_prompt: Fashion photography of a Tier 4 cyberpunk formal suit on a angular, augmented model: left arm is a sleek chrome prosthetic with articulated fingers, visible through the open-channel sleeve framing. Model wears the suit standing in a corporate atrium lit by cold fluorescent light that makes the matte-black Nullweave fabric read as pure shadow. The chrome toe-caps of boots catch sharp highlights. Unblemished BCI port visible at right temple, brushed steel catching subtle light. Right side of frame shows standard black sleeve. Cinematic, high-end corporate aesthetic. Moody blue-white lighting. Dark marble or steel background. --ar 2:3 --v 6
